attributes.board_name: Nebraska DHHS Licensure Unit / Board of Medicine and Surgery (Physician Assistants)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Category 1 coursework approved by ACCME, AOA or AAPA
rules.carryover: Up to 25 hours above the 50 required may be carried over to the next renewal period.
rules.alternatives: Instead of the 50 hours: meet NCCPA re-registration requirements within the 24 months before license expiration.

topics.who: All professionals who prescribe controlled substances: 3 hours on opioids, of which 0.5 hour on the Prescription Drug Monitoring Program (PDMP)

rules.notes: PA licenses expire October 1 of odd-numbered years. Hours must be earned in the 24 months before expiration. The 3 opioid/PDMP hours are part of the required CE (Neb. Rev. Stat. 38-145(6), LB 731).
